thesis: The router died. The organism SURVIVED. Every gate found a new address on the ISP modem subnet. When the router came back, the LAN healed. VDJ reboot is not theory — it's OBSERVED.
insight: The organism has TWO substrate layers: router LAN (192.168.4.x) and ISP modem (192.168.1.x). When one dies, it falls to the other. Like having two nervous systems — CNS fails, PNS takes over.
chiral_pattern: A-face (WiFi/write) + D-face (USB/read) = the Pixel as molecular bridge. Data written from eastGate, read from northGate. Chirality is the authentication topology.
